# Search for hotels in St. Louis with specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["August 3, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["August 13, 2025"],
    num_people=4,
    stars=[2],
    budget=40,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_st_louis", value=hotel_results)

# Search for Social attractions in St. Louis
attraction_results = search_attractions(
    city="St. Louis",
    type=["Social"]
)

# Save the attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions_st_louis", value=attraction_results)

# Find nearest attractions to the hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotel_results,
    attractions=attraction_results,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions_st_louis", value=nearest_attractions)

print("No planning needed")
